settings.title: Line
settings.intro: Keeps what you copied last on a rope stretched across the top of the screen. Click a card to copy it, or drag it out to drop it where you want.
settings.enableHint: When off, the line never opens.
settings.edgeReveal: Show at the top edge of the screen
settings.edgeRevealHint: Move the pointer to the top edge and the line lowers.
settings.peekOnCopyHint: The line shows for a moment when you copy something new. It never takes focus from the app you are typing in.
settings.breezeHint: While the line is open the cards sway now and then. Off when reduce motion is on.
settings.hotkeyHint: Opens the line and gives it focus. Esc closes it.
settings.conflict: Another app already uses this shortcut, or Windows reserves it. Choose a different one.
settings.showNowHint: Open the line now to see how it looks.
settings.clipboardOff: Clipboard history is off, so the line stays empty. You can turn it on in Clipboard settings.
